Subject: Renewal QBR: narrow attendee roster & ops dry-run

Hi Claire —

Thanks for continuing the renewal conversation — excited to walk through the roadmap and new performance controls in this QBR/demo. To keep the session focused (we've seen 90–120min sessions lose decision momentum), can we tighten the attendee list to the core decision makers + one technical lead and one procurement rep? Suggested roles: CPO, Head of Data, Lead SRE, and Procurement.

Proposed windows (all PDT):
- Tue 9/14 10:00–11:30
- Wed 9/15 14:00–15:30
- Thu 9/16 09:00–10:30

I attached a one-page agenda and proposed run-of-show; if you prefer, we can do a 60-minute condensed walkthrough + 30-minute tech breakout. Also recommend a quick ops dry-run the day before with your SRE and our infra team so the live demo KV cache warm-up goes smoothly.

Can you confirm preferred window and who you'll include? If you want, loop in Marc from procurement and IT folks so we can pre-check network/KMS questions.

Best,
